title: Activepieces Credits: Pricing and Usage (2026 Guide)
summary: Activepieces credits cost $0.007 each beyond your monthly allowance. Compare free (1,000), Plus ($20 for 10,000), and Team ($200 for 50,000) credits.
body_markdown:
## Spotting hidden costs and team limits


Watch for five limits that cost more than extra credits. The first two are the users and SSO that decide whether Team's $200 a month is enough:


- Team's 25-user cap
- Which tier carries SSO
- Whether unused credits roll over
- What level of support is included
- Engineering time to run a self-hosted install


### User and SSO ceilings


With 25 users and SSO included, Team can't hold a 40-person company building flows. Past 25 seats, or if you need SSO beyond what Team offers, you move to a sales quote, priced on users, credits, deployment and support.


Ask for rollover and support terms in writing during that quote, because they aren't part of the self-serve price either. **SOC 2's in progress, not certified** , so a procurement team that demands a report can't be satisfied today.


### Self-hosting: Community Edition versus a paid licence


When one technical team runs its own flows, needs no SSO and has someone to patch the server, the free Community Edition's enough.


A paid self-hosted licence is quoted by sales, and the quote buys the whole product rather than a trimmed build: SSO, SCIM, custom RBAC, audit logs, release management and secret managers work in the air-gapped edition as they do on the managed cloud.


Regulated and public-sector organisations run that edition in production, and MoneyGram, Moneypenny, Alan and FundingSocieties run Activepieces too. What never appears on the invoice is the hour spent on upgrades and incidents.


### Overage and budget surprises


Users run out of free credits before the month ends, because AI steps shrink the Free plan's 1,000 monthly credits faster than the headline suggests.


According to[Notelinker](https://www.notelinker.com/activepieces-pricing) , a flow with no AI step gets 1,000 runs a month, one with the cheapest AI step gets 333, and one with the priciest gets 47.


That means a flow built around the costliest AI step **exhausts Free in under two working days** of heavy use.


Past the allowance, those 21 credits a run cost about $0.147 at $0.007 a credit, so test your real flow before assuming the per-credit rate makes it cheap.
